name: marketing-logo-clouds
title: Logo Clouds
description: Client, partner, and integration logo showcase sections for marketing landing pages, displaying brand logos in horizontal rows, titled rows, and grid layouts to build credibility and social proof.
useWhen: Building credibility below the hero section by showing recognizable client or partner logos.
Showcasing integrations or supported platforms on a product or API landing page.
Demonstrating enterprise trust signals on a pricing or solutions page.
avoidWhen: Logos are not permitted for display by the referenced companies — always verify usage rights.
The logos are too small or visually inconsistent to read at display size — use text names instead.
The section would contain fewer than three logos — a single logo is better placed in a testimonial.
responsiveBehavior: Logo rows reduce column count on mobile, wrapping to additional rows or scrolling horizontally. Grid layouts collapse from six columns on desktop to three on mobile.
accessibility: Each logo image must have alt text naming the company, e.g. alt='Acme Corp' — do not use empty alt for logos that identify real companies.
If logos link to partner pages, each <a> must have aria-label describing the destination.
Decorative styling (grayscale filter, opacity) should not reduce logos below WCAG contrast thresholds.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Horizontal row of client or partner logos with no heading — the minimal logo cloud for placement between hero and feature sections.
accessibility: Each logo has alt text naming the company; logos displayed at consistent visual weight.

variants.title: Base with title
variants.description: Logo row with a centered headline such as 'Trusted by 500+ companies' to provide context before the logos.
accessibility: Section heading introduces the logo cloud; each logo img has a company-name alt.

variants.title: Base with title left aligned
variants.description: Logo cloud with a left-aligned headline and logos in a row — for sections where left alignment matches surrounding content.
accessibility: Left-aligned heading introduces the logos; logos remain in a responsive row at smaller screens.

variants.title: Grid
variants.description: Grid of logos in a bordered card layout — for integration showcases or partner directories where logos should be equally weighted and scannably arranged.
accessibility: Grid logos each have company-name alt; grid collapses to fewer columns on narrow viewports.
